name: Icebind Solo
description: The Icebind for 1 to 6 Tenno (opt-in). Ring a Cryobell starts its countdown once every squad member present has offered a Cryobell; the maximum stays 6, and the one-of-each-Warframe rule, voting, tie-break and countdown are stock. In the mission, complication scaling uses the real squad size (the game's own Clamp(players, 1, 6)) instead of a fixed 6. Two exact-key script replacements for client 44.1.0.
